# Uploading new content to existing import code

Source: [2004](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/2004); edited 2023-10-19. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-2004-n1"></a>

- Documented in-game update workflow: lobby Settings > Share > Upload to Existing Code, enter the existing import code, Continue, then wait for update. Reuses a code instead of creating a new one.

Source limitations:

- October 2023 UI instructions; no ownership, permissions, expiration, or rollback behavior documented.

- Remote walkthrough/media were not fetched; textual workflow read in full.
